text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which morning tea should I have 
today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should just pass on it today 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That sound of a favorite cup shattering. 
Even knowing it was just a dream... it 
isn't something easily forgotten, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I hope I don't have to see it again.

Plagued by bad dreams, Mejiro Ardan was 
not feeling at her best.
